# Now let's parse all notes and build the CSV data.
import csv
from io import StringIO

# Define habit order as per the logs (consistent across all notes)
habit_order = [
    "exercised_atleast_30_mins",
    "ate_homemade_meals",
    "practiced_meditation",
    "read_atleast_30_mins",
    "drank_adequate_water",
    "slept_over_7_hrs",
    "wrote_gratitude_journal",
    "limited_screen_time_to_1_hr",
    "practiced_good_posture",
    "connected_with_friends"
]

# Parse each note
rows = []
for note in notes_data:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = note['title']
    date_str = title.replace("Habit Tracking Log for ", "").strip()
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip the first line (header) and any empty lines
    habit_values = {}
    for line in content_lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            habit_values[habit] = value
    # Build row: date + values in habit_order
    row = [date_str] + [habit_values.get(h, 'no') for h in habit_order]
    rows.append(row)

# Sort by date descending
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0], reverse=True)

# Build CSV content
output = StringIO()
writer = csv.writer(output)
writer.writerow(['date'] + habit_order)
writer.writerows(rows)
csv_content = output.getvalue()
print(csv_content)
